name: Ryu Cloud Search
description: Web search through Ryu Cloud's hosted search service, exposed as the swappable `web.search` layer. Selecting it re-points the stable `web.search` tool at Ryu Cloud without changing what agents call. No search provider key is needed: Core forwards each query to the hosted Gateway with this node's Ryu Cloud credential, and each successful search is billed to the organization's credit balance as Web search usage. Requires a node connected to Ryu Cloud with managed inference; an organization admin can turn hosted search off. When it is unavailable the tool returns a readable reason instead of failing the turn.
tagline: Web search billed to your Ryu Cloud credits

config.description: Search the public web through Ryu Cloud's hosted search. Returns up to 10 results with title, URL and a snippet. Each successful search is billed to the organization's Ryu Cloud credits. Returns `available: false` with a reason when this node is not connected to Ryu Cloud, the organization turned hosted search off, or credits are exhausted.

query.description: What to search for, up to 400 characters.
